rundown: Spartans beat Spartans 85-66 at Bodford Arena in Greensboro, NC. Spartans led 41-25 at half-time and never looked back. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 79%).
Leading the way — Spartans: Jalyn Patterson 18 pts, 3 ast; Amont'e Allen-Johnson 4 reb. Spartans: Dionte Neal 14 pts, 3 ast; Cameron Grant 9 reb.
Where Spartans won it: they shot 58% to 48%, won the boards 36-22 and had 15 assists to 14.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Spartans closed as 6.5-point favorites and covered by 12.5; the total closed at 145.5 and they combined for 151, over by 5.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 21, 10:59 AM ET. It had Spartans 26% and Spartans 74%, projecting Spartans 72.6 – Spartans 79.8 (152.4 total, Spartans by 7.1).

Final: Spartans 66 – Spartans 85. Right winner: it had Spartans at 74%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Spartans came in with a 8% below average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (1-5, 73.5 scored and 73.7 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 186 and 184 games of evidence. Projected to score 72.6, they scored 66 (−6.6 points, 9% under); projected to allow 79.8, they allowed 85 (+5.2 points, 7% over).

Spartans came in with a 3% below average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (3-2, 80.4 scored and 71 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 177 and 177 games of evidence. Projected to score 79.8, they scored 85 (+5.2 points, 7% over); projected to allow 72.6, they allowed 66 (−6.6 points, 9% under).

The bigger miss was Spartans' scoring (-6.6 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 151 against 152.4 projected (-1.4), about the 46th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Spartans by 19 against Spartans by 7.1 projected, about the 86th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
UNCG ML (-270) at -270: the algo gave it 70% vs 70% fair (+0.3 pts) — won (+0.4u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 71%). UPST ML (+220) at +220: the algo gave it 30% vs 30% fair (-0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 29%). UNCG -6.5 (-102) at -102: the algo gave it 48% vs 48% fair (+0.2 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. UPST +6.5 (-118) at -118: the algo gave it 52% vs 52% fair (-0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 145.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 50% vs 49% fair (+1.2 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. UNDER 145.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 50% vs 51% fair (-1.2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): total: 74% of bets on the over, 76% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 5% of bets on Spartans, 5% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Spartans, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.971 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +13 points. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 873 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.980 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Spartans attack ×0.998, defense ×0.991 (6 games); Spartans attack ×1.011, defense ×1.005 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 11.9 points), no bet.
